title: DepthTile: Depth-Guided Existing-Image Self-Tiling with Input-Side Tileability Assessment
title_zh: DepthTile：基于深度引导的现有图像自平铺及输入端平铺能力评估

paragraphs.en: DepthTile 是一种深度引导的图像自平铺方法，通过结合单目深度信息和扩散模型提高图像的自平铺效果。 Existing-image self-tiling aims to transform a given image into a seamlessly repeatable tile while preserving its original semantics and local details. This task requires weak editing to retain the source but leave periodic seams, whereas strong editing improves tileability at the large risk of content drift.Existing diffusion-based tiling pipelines alleviate boundary discontinuities, yet lack awareness of which regions are geometrically important to preserve. In this work, we propose DepthTile, a depth-guided self-tiling method whose generation module requires no retraining of the diffusion backbone. It converts monocular depth into a spatial preservation prior and integrates it into the timestep-dependent masking mechanism of Tiled Diffusion. DepthTile converts depth into a spatial editability map and fuses it with the differential diffusion mask. This strengthens source preservation in near-field regions indicated by the monocular depth prior while retaining editing flexibility near compatible background boundaries. To access when self-tiling is feasible, we introduce the Self-Tiling Ability Score (STAS), a lightweight input-side predictor based on RGB, gradient, depth, and depth-gradient cues. On a 335-image benchmark, relative to the default Tiled Diffusion pipeline, DepthTile reduces MAE, LPIPS, and Tiling Score by 12.8%, 26.7%, and 8.4%, respectively. STAS reliably enables difficulty-aware analysis and further supports compatibility-aware pairwise image tiling.
paragraphs.zh: DepthTile 是一种深度引导的图像自平铺方法，通过结合单目深度信息和扩散模型来提升图像的自平铺效果。现有图像的自平铺技术旨在将给定图像转换为可无缝重复使用的平铺单元，同时保留其原始语义和局部细节。 这项任务需要弱编辑以保留原始内容但留下周期性接缝，而强编辑虽然能提升平铺性，却存在内容漂移的高风险。现有的基于扩散模型的平铺流程虽能缓解边界不连续问题，但缺乏对哪些区域在几何结构上需要保留的判断能力。 在本研究中，我们提出了 DepthTile——一种深度引导的自平铺方法，其生成模块无需对扩散模型主干进行重新训练。 该方法将单目深度信息转化为空间保留先验，并将其整合到 Tiled Diffusion 的时间步依赖掩码机制中。 DepthTile 将深度信息转换为空间可编辑性地图，并与微分扩散掩码进行融合。 这能在单目深度先验所指示的近场区域中强化原始内容的保留，同时保持与兼容背景边界附近区域的编辑灵活性。 为了判断自平铺是否可行，我们引入了自平铺能力得分（STAS），这是一种基于 RGB、梯度、深度及深度梯度线索的轻量级输入端预测器。 在包含 335 张图像的基准测试中，与默认的 Tiled Diffusion 流程相比，DepthTile 分别将 MAE、LPIPS 和平铺得分降低了 12.8%、26.7% 和 8.4%。 STAS 能够可靠地实现难度感知的分析，并进一步支持基于兼容性的成对图像平铺。
